title: Vietnamese Chicken Noodle Soup
description: A comforting and flavorful soup originating from Vietnam, made with chicken and noodles.

ingredients.name: noodles
ingredients.notes: Rice stick noodles or egg noodles

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, garlic, and ginger, and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Add the noodles and cook according to the package instructions.
Stir in the fish sauce and soy sauce, and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Simmer the soup for 5-7 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped herbs or scallions if desired.
